decision.answer: Write canonical JANUS-compatible JSON records directly; append safely as JSONL/NDJSON on embedded storage, then seal/compact into ordinary JSON chunks/manifests.
decision.cross_node_storage: chunk manifest + durable receiver ACK + provenance
decision.corrections: append a correction/superseding record; never silently edit past records
decision.truth_guard: hash integrity is not evidence that the measurement itself was correct

compatibility.meta_registry: direct ingest without semantic format conversion
